name: Camping 101: Tailoring
summary: A tailoring trainer can show you how to make a Faction Banner for your camp. Bowen Brisboise teaches the craft once you prove your skill.

sections.title: A Banner for Camp
sections.body: A tailoring trainer points you to Bowen Brisboise on the road from Deathknell to Brill. Prove your skill to him, and he can teach you to make a Faction Banner for your camp. A banner can help keep you encouraged in the field.

sections.title: Setting Up Camp
sections.body: Bowen Brisboise teaches you to make a Rallying Banner. To try it, you need to set your camp in the wilderness, since most folk dislike camps in town. You also need a campfire, which a cook can teach you to make.

faq.answer: Bowen Brisboise can teach you to craft a Faction Banner once you prove your tailoring skill.

faq.q: Where can I find Bowen Brisboise?
faq.answer: Bowen Brisboise is on the road from Deathknell to Brill.

faq.q: What can tailoring make for a camp?
faq.answer: Tailoring can teach you to make a Faction Banner for your camp.
The banner you learn to craft is called a Rallying Banner.
Yes. You need a campfire before setting up camp, and a cook can teach you to make one.
